inputs: Assembly hashes; culture/run aliases; type accessions; study/host/site metadata; phenotype data dictionary.
method: One row per independent culture/experimental unit. Separate public reads, public assemblies and study isolates; retain biological replicates as grouped observations. Preserve unknown values.
pass_rule: Every analysed observation has an unambiguous genome join. Decode assay endpoints, units and -1/-2 before phenotype inference. R22/R23/R24 remain unknown where unsupported.
output: Frozen cohort and eligibility matrix, with genomic-only and phenotype-eligible subsets.
benefit: Avoid duplicate counting and false phenotype associations.

inputs: Complete BenA/CaM/RPB2 tree, verified types, locus-copy audit, current core tips.
method: Use the new type-exclusive monophyly assignments as working labels; test locus concordance and alternative markers/backbones for uncertain boundaries. No genome-wide ANI cutoff is assumed for fungi.
pass_rule: All labels trace to included type anchors. Resolve weak A. terreus/A. alabamensis boundaries and the A. montoensis/A. terreus core conflicts before making strong species-level evolutionary claims.
output: Type-qualified species map with uncertainty and label-history table.
benefit: Separate sister-species differences from within-species trait evolution.
status: PARTIAL: figures complete; 24 core tips are topology-only assignments.

inputs: Harmonised proteins; single-copy orthogroups; core alignments and per-locus trees; justified outgroups.
method: Use a fungal orthology workflow (e.g. OrthoFinder), ML species backbone and IQ-TREE gCF/sCF; compare locus trees and supported alternatives. Evaluate recombination/introgression when indicated.
pass_rule: Exact cohort matching, validated orthology/copy choice and adequate support. A biological root and sensitivity to plausible alternative trees are required for directional ancestral claims.
output: Audited rooted backbone plus uncertainty trees and discordance map.
benefit: Avoid assigning gains/losses to an uncertain or merely display-rooted tree.
status: OPEN: current core is a comparison topology, not a validated ASR backbone.

inputs: Unmasked genomes; fungal gene models; validated Lov proteins; flanks; assembly gaps; reads where available.
method: Use BLAST/tBLASTn or protein-to-genome alignment, domain evidence, fungal antiSMASH and synteny to curate orthologues, intact ORFs, duplications, orientation and neighbourhoods.
pass_rule: Separate intact, disrupted, duplicated, absent and uncallable. Absence requires a callable interval and negative homology evidence; missing reads or contig breaks are not absence.
output: Gene/cluster state matrix with evidence, flanking synteny and confidence.
benefit: Distinguish biological architecture changes from assembly/annotation failure.
status: PARTIAL: architecture figures exist; character validation remains a gate.

inputs: Species map, callability-aware orthogroup/BGC matrix, defensible habitat and measured traits.
method: Clustered heatmaps; Jaccard for comparable binary profiles or Gower for mixed measured traits; PCoA/NMDS; dispersion-aware PERMANOVA with species/study-blocked permutations.
pass_rule: Choose denominators and missing-data handling first; show ordination stress, dispersion and sampling sensitivity. Do not treat correlated cultures as independent.
output: Species/lineage-stratified architecture atlas and adjusted ecological effect sizes.
benefit: Reveal whether cluster patterns follow ancestry, environment or within-species diversity.
status: PROPOSED: descriptive genomic pilot can follow E0-E3.

inputs: E2 rooted uncertainty trees and E3 validated discrete states; independent culture subset.
method: phytools::fitMk with ER/SYM/ARD as data permit; make.simmap with repeated batches and tree/root/rate-prior sensitivity. Use phylosig or BM/OU only for suitable continuous measurements.
pass_rule: Adequate independent changes, stable model fits and simulations. Unknowns stay uncertain. Show state/transition distributions; do not read a single reconstruction as an observed event.
output: Posterior ancestral-state pies and distributions of gains, losses and duplications.
benefit: Test retention versus repeated loss or independent architectural change.
status: NOT RUN: root, characters and transition-information gates must pass.

inputs: Curated genome characters; assay units/endpoints; condition-matched metabolomics/RNA-seq if available.
method: Phylogenetic/mixed models with species and study effects; within-species contrasts; lineage-held-out validation. Use Terrnet 211 WT/sector as a paired experimental contrast, not independent taxa.
pass_rule: Prespecified endpoint/covariates, sufficient independent contrasts and multiplicity control. Sequence presence is not production; a BGC/phenotype association is not causation.
output: Effect sizes and uncertainty linking cluster integrity/regulation to measured phenotypes.
benefit: Prioritise testable mechanisms behind metabolite or developmental differences.
status: HOLD for unresolved phenotype units/codes; no substitute values inferred.

inputs: E3-E6 candidate changes; locus trees, flanks, repeats, coverage; independent strains or experiments.
method: Reconcile BGC/core histories; test duplication/loss, structural variation and candidate transfer with synteny/read support. Validate leading hypotheses by independent data, expression/metabolite assays or targeted genetics.
pass_rule: Rule out paralogy, contamination, gaps and root sensitivity. Gene-tree discordance alone is not horizontal transfer. Clinical/predictive claims require independent endpoint-linked validation.
output: Ranked, evidence-backed hypotheses and an experimental validation shortlist.
benefit: Turn descriptive evolution into falsifiable biological explanations.
status: PROPOSED: claim level follows the evidence, not a composite risk score.
